newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on active short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on active short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Tuesday, as private investors accelerated efforts to cover their shorts, backed by a view that Japan's bumper rubber stocks will fall, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 1.6 yen per kilogram higher. Benchmark April was 1.6 yen firmer at 144.5 yen.

"Encouraged by falls in rubber stocks announced on Monday, sentiment turned moderately bullish," one trader said. The yen's weaker tendency also supported the market. "Prices could rise further if more bullish factors emerge," he said.
